Maxims of Theognis: I am much tost-about in
Sonnet CLVI (In Life): Under the Figure of a Tempest-Tossed Vessel, He Describes His Own Sad State
There was an old woman toss'd up in a basket
Toss not my soul, O Love, 'twixt hope and fear!
Thrice toss these oaken ashes in the air
Acts 27:41: The batter'd ship, by tempest toss'd
1 Corinthians 16:13: Toss'p too long by every wind
To the Afflicted, Tossed with Tempests and Not Comforted
Where ships of purple gently toss
